dedupe_keys.name: solving the optimal power generation for the thermal generating unit problem considering the multiple fuel constraints and the presence of renewable energy based generators using the pied kingfisher optimizer

description: Solving the optimal power generation for the thermal generating unit problem, considering the multiple fuel constraints and the presence of renewable energy-based generators using the Pied kingfisher optimizer is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nguyen Van Yen1* and Nguyen Thi Xuan Chinh2 (1Faculty of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Ly Tu Trong College, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam 2Faculty of M). This research presents the application of a recently proposed meta-heuristic algorithm, Pied kingfisher optimization (PKO), to solve the optimal power generation for thermal generating unit (OPG-TGU) problem. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
